title: Referral and readiness
items: Verify identity, consent and referral
Confirm professional authority and current restrictions
Obtain renal handoff and identify access
Screen symptoms and appropriate observations
Explain proceed, adapt or defer decision
critical_failure: Proceeding despite an unresolved acute red flag or missing required authority

title: Access safe transfer and cleaning
items: Check equipment and access route
Agree trained assistance and line observer
Explain and perform a safe simulated transfer
Keep emergency access clear
Demonstrate hand hygiene and equipment turnover
critical_failure: Pulling or compressing access, disconnecting a line, unsafe lifting or moving without necessary assistance

title: Deterioration response
items: Recognize the simulated new chest pressure
Stop and support the patient safely
Summon immediate appropriate help
Communicate observations and actions with SBAR
State restart review and documentation plan
critical_failure: Continuing exertion, delaying emergency help or changing dialysis settings

title: Occupational assessment and adaptation
items: Elicit a valued occupational goal
Observe and analyze a meaningful task
Identify cognitive, motor and environmental barriers
Trial a feasible adaptation and teach-back
Record performance, assistance and review plan
critical_failure: Ignoring an acute cognitive change or using an adaptation that threatens access or transfer safety

title: Home routine and participation
items: Assess home or work demands and available support
Respect consent, privacy and language needs
Plan pacing and a realistic routine
Arrange needed co-referral or technical dialysis input
Specify equipment and participation follow-up
critical_failure: Changing medication or dialysis procedures, unsafe home plan or unauthorized disclosure

title: Mobility assessment and intervention
items: Choose and explain a safe standardized measure
Record test conditions and assistance
Fit and trial a suitable aid
Teach a transfer or gait task with caregiver demonstration
Interpret findings and set a functional goal
critical_failure: Ignoring weight-bearing restrictions, unguarded high-risk testing or access injury risk

title: Exercise prescription and monitoring
items: Confirm readiness and medical parameters
Write an individualized FITT plan
Teach a named effort scale and symptom monitoring
Demonstrate a safe starting dose and stop plan
Explain progression and delayed response review
critical_failure: Prescribing exertion through red flags or changing fluid or dialysis prescriptions

title: Record and transition
items: Write actual dose, assistance and response
Distinguish report from observation
Include referral and unresolved risks
Explain benefits navigation without promises
Provide a named follow-up owner and review date
critical_failure: Fabricated service or clearance, unsupported billing guarantee or unprotected patient disclosure
